title: Fitness Demon Selfie
description: A woman with short platinum hair in pink and purple athletic wear stands in a gym, holding a smartphone with a cute purple devil face on its screen that is emitting sparkles. To her right, a large black cartoon demon with glowing white eyes and sharp teeth emerges from swirling purple and orange abstract shapes.
prompt: A confident woman with short platinum blonde hair wearing pink and purple sportswear stands in a gym, holding a smartphone with a cute purple devil emoji face on the screen emitting magical sparkles. A large black cartoon demon with glowing white eyes, horns and sharp grin appears beside her from swirling purple and orange abstract shapes and tentacles. White line art flowers in the foreground, cinematic lighting, vibrant colors, digital art style.
